title: Membership in the coordinate zero subspace
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $C$ be a set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $x$ be a point of the $n$-coordinate vector space over $\mathbb F_2$. Then $x$ belongs to the kernel of restriction to $C$ if and only if $x_i=0$ for every $i\in C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a point of the binary vector space
